subject.title: [Feature]: Support Anthropic native server-side tools (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution)

question: Should OpenClaw support Anthropic web_fetch and code_execution/PTC with allowed_callers as first-class Anthropic plugin behavior, and what opt-in/security/replay policy should govern it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the remaining work changes provider-hosted execution, billing, tool permissions, auth routing, and transcript replay semantics that automation should not choose by default.

options.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
options.body: Define an explicit Anthropic plugin/API surface for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

options.title: Split narrow trackers
options.body: Let narrower issues handle native web_search and advisor/server-block behavior while keeping separate product decisions for web_fetch and code_execution/PTC.

options.title: Defer hosted execution
options.body: Keep client-side fetch/search and existing provider tools as the supported path for now, without Anthropic code_execution/PTC support.

recommendation.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
recommendation.body: Define an explicit Anthropic plugin/API surface for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the most recent visible review context and strong recent history on the Anthropic plugin/provider boundary.
